chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Ali ibn Hadeed, from Sayf ibn 'Amira, from 'Amr ibn Shimr, from Jabir, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:
The Sunnah is that the bier (coffin) is carried from its four sides, and whatever carrying is done after that is voluntary.

key_terms.السَّرِيرُ: The bier or coffin used to carry the deceased

ai.seo_question: What is the Sunnah method for carrying a coffin in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the normative practice (Sunnah) of carrying the bier from its four corners, a method rooted in the traditions of the Ahl al-Bayt to ensure dignity and stability. By classifying other methods as voluntary (tatawwu'), the text highlights the Shia scholarly distinction between the recommended ideal and permissible variations, reflecting the flexibility within ritual jurisprudence (fiqh) while maintaining adherence to prophetic precedent.
